newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu quietly ends down at 3,220/30 vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu quietly ends down at 3,220/30 vs dlr.

text.p: 1320 GMT - The Romanian leu currency closed Monday down slightly at 3,220/30 against the dollar after lingering at 3,200/10 throughout the day in a dormant interbank market.
* Operators said trading was lethargic with dollar owners unhappy with present rates even though prices have recently started to ease towards more realistic levels.
* Latest central bank data showed $200,000 interbank turnover on Friday when overall trading stood at $11.4 million.
* Leu-dollar retail rates wavered around 3,470-3,500, and traders said prices seemed capped at these levels by leu shortages plaguing exchange bureaux.
* One-week rates lingered at some 56 percent. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
